name: Huntarr-Radarr
description:
DEPRECATED: Use Huntarr instead. 
        [br]
        Huntarr (Radarr Edition) continually searches your Radarr library for missing movies or movies that need quality upgrades. It automatically triggers searches for both missing movies and movies below your quality cutoff. It's designed to run continuously while being gentle on your indexers, helping you gradually complete your movie collection with the best available quality.
requires: Requires a separate Radarr v4 instance.

variables.name: Radarr - API Key
variables.description: API key for your Radarr instance

variables.name: Radarr - Skip Future Releases
variables.description: Skip processing movies with release dates in the future

variables.name: Huntarr - Missing Movies Per Cycle
variables.description: Maximum missing movies to process per cycle. Set to 0 to disable.

variables.name: Huntarr - Upgrade Movies Per Cycle
variables.description: Maximum upgrade movies to process per cycle. Set to 0 to disable.

variables.name: Huntarr - Use Random Selection
variables.description: Use random selection for processing if enabled, or sequential if disabled.

variables.name: Huntarr - Minimum Queue Size
variables.description: Minimum number of items in the download queue before starting a hunt. Set to -1 to disable.

variables.name: Radarr - API Timeout
variables.description: Timeout for API requests in seconds.

variables.name: Huntarr - Sleep Duration
variables.description: Duration, in seconds, to wait between cycles.

variables.name: Huntarr - Reset Interval
variables.description: Interval, in hours, after which to reset the processed state files. Set to 0 to disable.

variables.name: Debug Mode
variables.description: Enable debug mode for detailed logging.

variables.name: Command Status - Wait Time
variables.description: Delay in seconds between checking for command status

variables.name: Command Status - Max Attempts
variables.description: Maximum number of attempts to check for command status
